nodes.label: Numbered collapsible tool/thinking items + pager
nodes.rationale: Thinking is never shown expanded outside the pager; item text is never used as a format string because summaries may contain %.

nodes.label: Paste chips [paste N lines #K]
nodes.rationale: Large pastes or pastes containing control bytes are stored aside and rendered as a plain-text chip marker so control bytes never reach the terminal, while full content is kept intact until send; the #K suffix disambiguates two pastes of the same length.

nodes.label: Sanitize escape neutralization (internal/tui/sanitize.go)
nodes.rationale: Replaces C0 controls and DEL with caret notation so pasted or tool-produced bytes are displayed, never interpreted by the terminal (ANSI escapes and bracketed-paste end markers render harmlessly).

nodes.label: ! and !! shell passthrough commands
nodes.rationale: !cmd output enters the conversation as a user message bypassing the model-facing analyser; !!cmd is local-only so it never pollutes the transcript.

nodes.label: Steering (messages queued during a run)
nodes.rationale: A message sent mid-run lands after the current tool batch results so the model sees tools then user text; if a turn had no tool calls it becomes the next user message; esc returns queued steering to the editor instead of the transcript.

nodes.label: Interactive trust prompt (trust.json)
nodes.rationale: Appears on first open of an untrusted workdir that has project resources (.moca/, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) because those files can steer the agent; the decision is saved so the prompt is asked once.

nodes.label: Yolo mode (/yolo, red YOLO status field)
nodes.norm_label: yolo mode (/yolo, red yolo status field)
nodes.rationale: Toggled between runs only because SetYolo swaps Env checkers and is not synchronized with the running agent goroutine; while on, the workdir is trusted without the trust prompt.

nodes.label: SSH/headless copy-URL paste-code fallback
nodes.rationale: When the local callback is unreachable (SSH, container, WSL, --no-browser) the authorize URL is printed and a pasted code or full redirect URL is accepted; the pasted state is verified so a URL from a different login attempt is refused.

nodes.rationale: Tokens live in ~/.local/share/moca/auth.json mode 0600 (dir 0700); refresh is held across read-refresh-write and a corrupt store names the file and suggests logout instead of overwriting silently.

nodes.label: Usage-anchored ContextTokens estimate
nodes.rationale: Anchors at real usage after each turn and adds chars/4 for appended entries, because a pure chars/4 estimate drifts from the provider-reported token count.

nodes.label: chars/4 token estimate (Tokens, MessageChars, RequestChars, UsageTokens)
nodes.norm_label: chars/4 token estimate (tokens, messagechars, requestchars, usagetokens)
nodes.rationale: Package compact never imports provider so summarization can be injected by agent in phase 4; the estimate is a cheap chars/4 fallback used before the first usage response arrives.

nodes.label: FIFO eventPipe bridge for agent events
nodes.norm_label: fifo eventpipe bridge for agent events
nodes.rationale: Program.Send is a blocking send on an unbuffered channel and Update runs on the event-loop goroutine, so a synchronous YoloChanged emitted from inside Update deadlocked the program; emit now only enqueues, order preserved.

nodes.label: Input state machine (internal/tui/input.go)
nodes.rationale: Pure state with no Bubble Tea types so it can be unit-tested; the buffer is exactly what the textarea shows, so chips need no special rendering hook.

nodes.label: JSONC-preserving array append (AppendString)
nodes.rationale: Comments, formatting and everything else stay byte-identical because allow-always edits a user-hand-edited config; writes a .bak then renames atomically.

nodes.label: Pure unit-tested core + thin Bubble Tea glue
nodes.norm_label: pure unit-tested core + thin bubble tea glue
nodes.rationale: The behaviour that matters (history transform, switching, steering, estimates, JSONC append, templates, status formatting, command parsing, input state machine, item store) lives in pure code so it is testable without a terminal; the glue maps terminal messages onto those functions.

nodes.label: Cross-process file lock (flock / LockFileEx)
nodes.rationale: Two moca processes refreshing the same expired token would burn a refresh token that rotates on use; the lock serializes refresh and losers re-read the store. Windows uses only stdlib syscall because a second non-UI dependency is not allowed.

nodes.label: OAuth policy gate / verification record
nodes.rationale: Before writing any OAuth code, vendor terms and endpoints are verified and recorded; unclear is treated as not permitted; no workarounds and no spoofed client identities (never reuse another product client id or user-agent); a provider that fails ships api_key only, enforced by config validation.

nodes.label: CredentialFunc seam (auth lives in internal/provider)
nodes.rationale: Credentials are a provider concern, so auth code lives in internal/provider and OAuth plugs in through the phase-1 Registry.SetOAuth seam with no adapter changes beyond the existing Credential.OAuth bearer switch; provider-specific OAuth parameters are data filled from the verification record.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md Project Instructions
nodes.rationale: Capped at 32K chars with a visible truncation note and gated behind project trust so untrusted repositories cannot inject instructions.

nodes.label: Embedded Built-in Skills Extraction (ExtractBuiltins)
nodes.rationale: Embedded skills are materialized to real paths so the model can read them through a read-only jail root (section 7).

nodes.label: Edit Ladder (exact / whitespace-insensitive / replace_all)
nodes.rationale: Errors are written for the model: ambiguity lists the matching lines, and a missed edit caused by read's N| line-number prefixes gets a targeted drop-the-prefixes hint.

nodes.label: Append-Only JSONL Session Transcript
nodes.rationale: Every entry carries id plus parentId and files are 0600/0700; ReadFile tolerates a truncated last line so a crash mid-write cannot corrupt the session.

nodes.label: maxSteps Wrap-Up (tool_choice none)
nodes.rationale: The wrap-up request uses tool_choice none and never removes tools so the prompt cache prefix stays stable.

nodes.label: One-Shot (-p) Output Contract and Exit Codes
nodes.norm_label: one-shot (-p) output contract and exit codes

nodes.label: Symlink-Resolving Path Jail with Read-Only Roots
nodes.norm_label: symlink-resolving path jail with read-only roots
nodes.rationale: Symlinks are resolved on the deepest existing ancestor so escapes via symlink are refused before any mkdir; read-only roots let the model read skill directories without write access.

nodes.label: Project Trust Store
nodes.rationale: Trust gates workdir/.moca/** and AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md; -p defaults to no unless --approve, following section 7's default-no rule literally.

nodes.label: ReadTracker Read-Before-Write Guard
nodes.rationale: write/edit refuse existing files that were never read in this session or that changed on disk since (mtime + size + sha256), preventing blind overwrites of stale content.

nodes.label: Sequential Tool Execution
nodes.rationale: Tool calls in one turn execute sequentially in emitted order and a failed call does not cancel the rest, so one bad call cannot stall a whole batch of work.

nodes.label: Seven Frozen Tools (read write edit shell search ls mcp)
nodes.norm_label: seven frozen tools (read write edit shell search ls mcp)
nodes.rationale: Tool schemas are frozen at the end of phase 2 (DESIGN.md section 4); a golden test locks them because a schema change is a v2 discussion.

nodes.label: Parsed Shell Command Analyser (shell-analysis ladder)
nodes.rationale: Commands are parsed with mvdan.cc/sh and refused rather than best-effort guessed when unparseable; the analyser is not a sandbox because an allowlisted interpreter can do anything the user can.

nodes.label: Pre-Edit Snapshots and Undo Stack
nodes.rationale: Pre-edit content is stored hash-addressed so undo can restore it; snapshots are skipped for git-tracked clean files because git already holds that content.

nodes.label: Once-Built System Prompt
nodes.rationale: The system prompt is built once, stored in the session entry and never rebuilt, for stability and prompt caching.

nodes.label: Tool Interface and Registry (tools.Tool, Result, Env, Registry)
nodes.norm_label: tool interface and registry (tools.tool, result, env, registry)
nodes.rationale: tools declares the Tool interface plus the small checker/snapshot interfaces it needs; checker implementations are injected through Env so tools never imports permissions or session.

nodes.label: Transcript Repair (synthetic tool results)
nodes.rationale: Every tool_use must have a tool_result for the transcript to stay valid to resend, so aborts and crashes get synthetic error results.

nodes.label: Yolo Mode (checker swapping)
nodes.rationale: Implemented by swapping the injected checkers, never by if-yolo branches inside tools - the payoff of the injection design; read-before-write guards, snapshots and shell env hygiene stay on because they are not permissions.

nodes.label: Phase 2 Plan - Seven Tools, Agent Loop, Permissions, Skills, Session Schema
nodes.norm_label: phase 2 plan - seven tools, agent loop, permissions, skills, session schema

nodes.label: Structural Interface Satisfaction (dependency direction)
nodes.rationale: permissions and session satisfy tools interfaces structurally without importing tools, keeping the dependency direction one-way (section 2); agent is the only package that imports everything, so permissive modes can be implemented by swapping injected checkers.

nodes.label: Token Discipline Principle
nodes.rationale: Every tool result costs tokens on every later turn, so the prompt mandates read windows over whole files, search before reading, and rtk-prefixed command variants.

nodes.label: Wrapped Command Allowlist Rule
nodes.rationale: rtk is allowlisted but the wrapped command is checked too (rtk <cmd> is only allowed when <cmd> is), so token compression cannot bypass the permission allowlist.

nodes.label: RewriteSecrets (literal secrets to env:MOCA_MCP_* indirection)
nodes.rationale: WHY: secrets are never copied literally - env/headers values whose key matches KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD|AUTH (case-insensitive) or whose value looks like a bearer token become env:MOCA_MCP_<SERVER>_<KEY>; ${VAR} references become env:VAR; the preview lists the variables to export without printing secret values.

nodes.label: TUI allow-always for the mcp kind
nodes.norm_label: tui allow-always for the mcp kind

nodes.label: shell tool (process-group kill, env hygiene, 30K truncation)
nodes.norm_label: shell tool (process-group kill, env hygiene, 30k truncation)

nodes.label: env:VAR indirection (lazy resolution)
nodes.rationale: WHY: an unset variable errors when the first request to that provider is built (naming the variable), never at startup, so unused providers don't block.

nodes.label: Yolo mode (checker swap)
nodes.rationale: WHY: yolo swaps the injected checkers (permissions.Unjailed, permissions.AllowAll, tools.AutoAllow) instead of adding if-yolo branches inside tools, so the lifts are uniform; maxSteps, read-before-write, snapshots and shell hygiene stay on.

nodes.label: Frozen mcp tool schema (phase 2 golden)
nodes.rationale: WHY: the schema {action: search|describe|call, server, tool, args, query} is frozen since phase 2; the proxy's Spec() must return tools.MCPSpec() byte-identically so the phase-2 golden test still passes.

nodes.label: One-critical-section Call (idle-timer race fix, rev 11)
nodes.rationale: WHY: the old two-section window (lookup unlocked its own lock, then Call re-locked) let the idle timer fire in between, close the transport and nil st.cl, so a call landing exactly at idle expiry panicked on the nil client; ensure + tool lookup + busy++ + timer stop now run under one st.mu critical section.

nodes.label: Lazy server lifecycle (zero eager spawning)
nodes.rationale: WHY: zero servers start at session start - servers start on first describe/call (or an index miss during search), stop after mcp.idleTimeout (default 600s), and stay discoverable via the persisted index; no eager spawning avoids running processes the session may never use.

nodes.label: MCP call gating (annotations / approve list / allow-always)
nodes.norm_label: mcp call gating (annotations / approve list / allow-always)
nodes.rationale: WHY: no name-pattern heuristics - a call runs without asking iff (readOnlyHint == true and destructiveHint != true) or the tool is in mcp.servers.<name>.approve (or the list contains '*'); otherwise a TUI prompt (allow-once / allow-always appended to approve); -p refuses.

nodes.label: No server tool lists in the prompt (roster lines only)
nodes.norm_label: no server tool lists in the prompt (roster lines only)
nodes.rationale: WHY: token efficiency - the prompt carries only the phase-2 roster lines (- name: description); full input schemas are fetched on demand via describe.

nodes.norm_label: tui event pipe with pre-start buffering

nodes.label: anthropic-messages adapter
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Adaptive thinking sends output_config.effort and must not send budget_tokens; budget mode sends budget_tokens = max_tokens − 4096; redacted_thinking must be replayed verbatim because filtering it triggers a 400; messages reduced to zero blocks are skipped.

nodes.label: ClampEffort / DefaultEffort
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Clamp to the nearest supported level at or below the request; nothing at or below means the lowest supported; non-thinking models clamp everything to off; default effort is clamp(medium).

nodes.label: DefaultShellAllow — default command allowlist
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: 32 entries; rtk and graphify are included from day 1 so the phase-6 external tools work without config changes.

nodes.label: config.EnvError — unset env: reference as usage error
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.norm_label: config.enverror — unset env: reference as usage error
nodes.rationale: A missing key is a configuration error mapped to exit code 2, raised lazily when the first request to that provider is built so an unused provider's missing key cannot block other providers.

nodes.label: Model catalog (builtinCatalog)
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Prices, context windows and max output are data verified from live vendor pages at implementation time, never invented; the catalog is mixed-protocol and records the check date in a comment.

nodes.label: openai-completions adapter
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Thinking blocks from history are not sent (the protocol has no slot — the §3 transform converts other-model thinking to text first); tool-call arguments are assembled per index and emitted only after the stream ends because cross-index completion order is not guaranteed.

nodes.label: openai-responses adapter
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Always store:false plus include reasoning.encrypted_content so reasoning replays statelessly; reasoning without its encrypted payload cannot be replayed and is skipped.

nodes.label: readSSE — SSE reader with stall timeout
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.norm_label: readsse — sse reader with stall timeout
nodes.rationale: Returns ErrStall after 90s with no data (the caller cancels the request so the body read unblocks); CRLF, missing space after 'data:', multi-line data, comment lines and blank keep-alives must parse identically; a clean end without the terminal event becomes io.ErrUnexpectedEOF so a proxy closing mid-response never reads as success.

nodes.label: Registry — config → (Model, Adapter)
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: URL precedence baseUrls[protocol] > baseUrl > built-in default; config model overrides merge with catalog entries rather than replace; cfg.Model/ModelHard validated at construction; credentials resolved lazily so a missing env key fails at request time, not at startup.

nodes.label: ResolveEnv — env: indirection
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Secrets never literal: apiKey must be an env:VAR reference and validation rejects anything else (§12); EnvRefs feeds the shell tool so referenced variables are removed from the model's environment (§4); non-env strings pass through for MCP headers.

nodes.label: retryable — error classification
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: 429/5xx/anthropic 529/stall/connection reset are retried; other 4xx, context overflow and cancellation are not; review added io.EOF, HTTP 408, ECONNREFUSED/EPIPE/ECONNABORTED and HTTP/2 GOAWAY as retryable, with retry-after capped at 60s.

nodes.label: SplitModel — provider-qualified model ids
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Model ids are provider/model split at the first '/' (§3).

nodes.label: Standardize — string-literal-aware JSONC pre-pass
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Comments and trailing commas are replaced by spaces preserving byte length and line structure so decode-error offsets still point at the right line:col; string literals (escapes honoured) are never touched.

nodes.label: WithRetry — uniform retry wrapper
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Backoff 1,2,4,8,16s with ±20% jitter honouring retry-after; up to 5 attempts before any event is emitted; after a mid-stream failure it emits EventReset and retries the same request exactly once; non-retryable errors surface immediately.

nodes.label: Ecosystem SKILL.md corpus (testdata/ecosystem)
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Byte-for-byte verbatim copies with provenance and licenses recorded in SOURCES.md, plus a synthetic edge-case fixture (CRLF, BOM, folded and literal descriptions, unquoted ': ', 1200-character description); when a fixture fails, fix the parser, never the fixture.

nodes.label: ExtractBuiltins — re-extract on content change
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Built-ins extract to builtin-skills/<mocaVersion>/; during development (0.0.0-dev) an existing extraction would shadow revised content, so re-extract when the embedded content hash differs from the .hash file.

nodes.label: skills frontmatter tolerant parser (frontmatter.go)
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Tolerant-parsing fixes found by the corpus: folded blocks with blank lines, quoted escapes via strconv.Unquote, inline vs block list-valued keys.

nodes.label: rtk subcommand classes (rtkSelf / rtkProxy / rtkDashDash)
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Captured from the real CLI and re-checked when bumping the rtk version the built-in skill documents; every other first word is treated as a wrapped command name.

nodes.label: rtkTarget — unwrap rtk argv
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Flags before the subcommand are skipped; a proxy sub yields the next word; a dash-dash sub yields the word after '--' (missing '--' means rtk runs its default, self); non-literal command names are refused.

nodes.label: Shell analyser unwrap (permissions)
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: unwrap returns the list of command-name indexes to classify: transparent wrappers (env, time, timeout, nice, nohup, command) are not classified while rtk is classified and then unwrapped.

nodes.rationale: Goal: the shell analyser unwraps `rtk <cmd>` so rtk never launders a non-allowlisted command; the built-in rtk skill matches the real CLI; SKILL.md and prompt-template files written for pi, Claude Code and OpenCode load unchanged.

nodes.label: built-in rtk SKILL.md
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Revised against rtk --help: every command shown must exist in the installed rtk; kept under ~40 lines because every session pays for it; the description is the only part always in context, so it is tuned to make the model prefer rtk.

nodes.label: docs/external-tools.md
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: How moca integrates external CLIs (allowlist + skill), the manual graphify install, and reusing skills/prompts from Claude Code / pi / OpenCode by copying or symlinking their dirs.

nodes.label: No secrets needed — stdlib-only build
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Because the project is standard-library only at this stage, CI needs no API keys or third-party services.

nodes.label: Anthropic cache breakpoints
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: cache_control ephemeral on system, on the last tool spec (end of the tools+system prefix, §3) and on the last eligible message block; thinking blocks cannot be cached directly so the breakpoint walks back; NoCacheWrite removes every cache_control because compaction summaries must never write the prompt cache (§6).

nodes.label: Dependency direction rule (§2)
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Every package may import internal/llm and internal/config; provider imports nothing else internal; llm imports nothing internal — vendor wire formats stay confined to the provider layer.

nodes.label: Exit codes 0 ok · 1 provider/runtime · 2 config/usage · 3 maxSteps · 130 interrupted
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.norm_label: exit codes 0 ok · 1 provider/runtime · 2 config/usage · 3 maxsteps · 130 interrupted
nodes.rationale: Separating usage/config failures (2) from runtime provider failures (1) and interruption (130) lets scripts branch reliably (§12.5); Ctrl-C during a stream or a backoff sleep stops retries and keeps stdout clean.

nodes.label: -p output contract (§12.5)
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: stdout carries only the final assistant text, buffered to the end of the stream and discarded on EventReset so a mid-stream retry cannot duplicate text into a pipe; stderr carries one-liners, retries and the token/cost exit summary; StopLength/StopRefusal print a diagnostic and exit 1.

nodes.label: Stdlib-only constraint — hand-rolled HTTP+SSE
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: No SDKs and no third-party deps in this phase (§3): net/http, encoding/json, flag and net/http/httptest for tests.

nodes.label: Ecosystem compatibility is a hard requirement
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.norm_label: ecosystem compatibility is a hard requirement
nodes.rationale: Any SKILL.md written for pi / claude-code / opencode (including graphify's and pi packages) loads unchanged — no edits to fixture files to make them pass.

nodes.label: rtk cannot launder a non-allowlisted command
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.norm_label: rtk cannot launder a non-allowlisted command
nodes.rationale: rtk proxy rm -rf x and rtk test -- sudo make must hit the same allowlist, hard-deny and ask-every-time rules as the bare commands, so wrapping can never bypass permission analysis.

nodes.label: Skill directories read-only via jail roots
nodes.community_name: Config, CLI Entry and rtk Ecosystem
nodes.norm_label: skill directories read-only via jail roots
nodes.rationale: Read-only roots are directory prefixes so supporting files (scripts/, references/) are readable but not writable; non-existent roots must be kept as absolute paths instead of being dropped at canonical() time.

nodes.label: Status bar rendering and width budget
nodes.norm_label: status bar rendering and width budget

nodes.label: compact.Budget (token budgets with small-window scaling)
nodes.rationale: Token-denominated rather than percentage-based: percentages would conflate a 200K and a 1M window; tokens don't (DESIGN §6).

nodes.label: compact.CapChars (summary input capping)
nodes.rationale: Serialized input is capped to the summarizer model's window, dropping the oldest whole lines first, so the summary request always fits.

nodes.label: compact.Entry + EntryTokens (neutral transcript view)
nodes.rationale: Keeps internal/compact provider-free and session-free: agent converts session entries into the neutral view.

nodes.label: compact.FindCut (cut-point selection)
nodes.rationale: Cuts never separate a tool call from its result; a cut at an assistant message inside a turn splits the turn and produces two merged summaries.

nodes.label: compact.Serialize (lossy serialization)
nodes.rationale: The summarizer doesn't need full tool outputs: results truncated at 2000 chars, headed COMPACTION NOTE (lossy).

nodes.label: compact.Summarizer (injected summary function)
nodes.rationale: Dependency injection keeps internal/compact provider-free: compact receives a Summarizer func rather than importing provider (DESIGN §2).

nodes.label: compact.TrackFiles (cumulative file tracking)
nodes.rationale: File lists accumulate across compactions (previous read/modified fed in) so later summaries never silently drop files.

nodes.label: session.FindForWorkdir (--continue lookup)
nodes.rationale: Canonical path comparison (filepath.Abs + EvalSymlinks) so --continue finds the session through a symlinked workdir.

nodes.label: session.Messages (compaction-aware request rebuild)
nodes.rationale: Request context rebuilds from the transcript: latest compaction summary + entries from firstKeptEntryId onward (DESIGN §8).

nodes.label: Phase review document (docs/reviews/)
nodes.source_location: Read-only review discipline: the review document is the only file a reviewer may create or change.

nodes.label: Usage-anchored token estimate
nodes.rationale: Last response's usage input+output tokens plus chars/4 of everything appended since — exact up to the delta, so code/CJK skew stays small.

nodes.label: Architecture and dependency direction (§2)
nodes.rationale: No cycles, ever; cross-package behaviour is injected by agent (Summarizer, PathChecker/CommandChecker) — the 'minimal' promise made structural.

nodes.label: Config: JSONC, typed, fail-fast (§12)
nodes.rationale: JSONC over TOML: stdlib-parseable (comment-strip pre-parse + encoding/json) and matches the house dotfiles merge machinery.

nodes.label: Context manager: budgets, compaction, overflow (§6)
nodes.rationale: Token-denominated budgets (a percentage conflates a 200K and a 1M window); a tight agent loop + disciplined context handling beats a feature-rich agent on cost-per-task.

nodes.label: Lazy MCP proxy (§10.5)
nodes.rationale: The eager approach (inject every server's tool schemas) is the single fastest way to destroy a lean context; one fixed ~200-token proxy tool, servers start lazily.

nodes.label: Permissions: path jail, shell analysis, trust (§7)
nodes.norm_label: permissions: path jail, shell analysis, trust (§7)
nodes.rationale: Honest threat model: guard rails against model mistakes and casual prompt injection, not a sandbox.

nodes.label: System prompt: built once, stored in session (§13)
nodes.norm_label: system prompt: built once, stored in session (§13)
nodes.rationale: A rebuilt prompt embeds fresh git state and invalidates the prompt cache on every commit the agent itself makes (self-sabotage of the edit→test→commit loop).

nodes.label: The seven tools, frozen for v1 (§4)
nodes.norm_label: the seven tools, frozen for v1 (§4)
nodes.rationale: Schema churn rule: JSON schemas frozen after phase 2 — every session re-reads schemas and tool-list churn kills prompt-cache reuse.

nodes.label: Phase 4 Plan: Context Manager, Compaction, Resume
nodes.norm_label: phase 4 plan: context manager, compaction, resume

nodes.label: Loop guard (no compaction loops)
nodes.rationale: If a compaction leaves the estimate above the trigger, stop with an error naming the largest entries instead of compacting forever; never compact twice in a row.

nodes.label: Overflow compact-and-retry (one attempt)
nodes.rationale: Provider overflow or a length stop with the context full triggers exactly one compact-and-retry as a fresh turn; the overflowing response is not persisted, a second overflow surfaces the original error.

nodes.label: Small-window scaling (min(reserve, window/4))
nodes.rationale: Keeps the 16K/20K defaults from swamping local models with 32K windows; models with contextWindow < 16384 are refused.

nodes.label: Split-turn two-summary merge
nodes.rationale: Cutting at an assistant message whose turn started earlier summarizes prior history and the in-progress turn separately, merged under '## Current turn (in progress)'.

nodes.label: Cut-point rule: never orphan a tool result
nodes.norm_label: cut-point rule: never orphan a tool result
nodes.rationale: Results must stay with their call — every provider rejects a tool call without a result, so the transcript must remain valid to resend.

nodes.label: Extension model: skills + slash commands + allowlist + lazy MCP
nodes.norm_label: extension model: skills + slash commands + allowlist + lazy mcp
nodes.rationale: No binary plugin system in v1 (probably ever): three composable standards-based mechanisms plus the lazy mcp proxy cover extensibility; a fifth mechanism needs a design revision.

nodes.label: Loop guard (§6)
nodes.rationale: If a compaction leaves the context still above the trigger, moca stops with an error naming the oversized entries instead of compacting again.

nodes.label: Persistent allow-always moved to ctrl+a: a first letter after a typing pause is indistinguishable from a deliberate keystroke, so timing heuristics cannot make prose keys safe for a persistent action
nodes.norm_label: persistent allow-always moved to ctrl+a: a first letter after a typing pause is indistinguishable from a deliberate keystroke, so timing heuristics cannot make prose keys safe for a persistent action

nodes.label: Model/effort switching (SetModel, SetEffort)
nodes.rationale: Resolves credentials first (CheckCredential, env lookup only, no network) so a switch fails fast with the env-var error and nothing changes; switching forfeits the prompt cache and the commands say so.

nodes.label: Cross-provider history transform (TransformHistory)
nodes.rationale: Thinking is replayed verbatim only to the exact producing model; foreign thinking becomes a [prior reasoning] text block and tool-call ids are normalized so other providers accept the transcript; input is never mutated so the session file keeps originals.

nodes.label: Thinking replay verbatim (signature-bound)
nodes.rationale: WHY: signatures/encrypted payloads are bound to the producing model - replaying them elsewhere (or unsigned) is a 400 on every later turn; anything else degrades to a text block.

nodes.label: Inline rendering, no alt-screen
nodes.rationale: Finished output goes to terminal scrollback via tea.Println and is never redrawn; only the live region re-renders, so agent output survives in the normal terminal history.
